# ASIN Data API

ASIN Data API provides detailed product data from Amazon, including price, rank, reviews, and more, enabling real-time insights for e-commerce professionals, marketers, and data analysts.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/asin-data-api/.

## Actions

- **Clear multiple collection requests**: Delete multiple requests from a collection by ids.
- **List Collection Requests** (read-only): List all requests in a collection (paginated).
